briefing: Stocks fell today. The NASDAQ dropped 1.3% and the S&P 500 lost 0.7%, so the market is in risk-off mode and the screener returned no buy candidates. We are holding all 7 positions with no changes. Our automatic stop-loss and profit-target rules stay in place, and the $445.88 in cash is below the $500 buy threshold anyway.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Risk-off is a market mood where investors pull money out of riskier assets like tech and growth stocks and move it somewhere safer. You can often spot it when the NASDAQ falls more than the broader S&P 500, as it did today. Many disciplined investors hold off on new purchases during risk-off days and wait for a clearer upswing before they buy.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「避險情緒」（Risk-Off）是指投資者從科技股、成長股等高風險資產撤資，轉往較穩健的地方。一個常見的訊號是納斯達克的跌幅大於整體標普500，正如今日的走勢。不少紀律嚴謹的投資者會在避險日暫停建倉，等待更明確的升勢才出手。

market_education.summary_en: US stocks fell broadly today, with the tech-heavy NASDAQ (-1.3%) dropping almost twice as much as the S&P 500 (-0.7%). That gap means investors were selling growth and technology names first, which usually happens when they move away from risk. No news headlines came with today's data, so we can't point to a specific cause; the price action alone shows a cautious, defensive mood.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日普遍走弱，以科技股為主的納斯達克指數下跌1.3%，跌幅接近標普500指數（-0.7%）的兩倍。成長股與科技股首當其衝，反映資金傾向避險、減持高估值板塊。由於今日數據並未附帶新聞標題，暫時無法確定具體觸發因素，但單從盤面走勢已可見市場情緒轉趨保守。
